title: Weather stations: another station and the open data of the Danish Meteorological Institute
intro: The lower part of the tab reads open weather data of the Danish Meteorological Institute (a free key of your own is needed) and a groundwater series for the lower boundary of the soil column.

marks.d: The free interface key of the Danish open data service.
Reads the daily series and makes it the weather in use.
A table with a date column and a depth to water column in metres, or a NetCDF file, used as the lower boundary of the soil column.
